outputs.final_proof:
\begin{proof}
Let $\bar a,\bar b,\bar c\in\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z$. By definition of multiplication on residue classes,
\[
(\bar a\cdot\bar b)\cdot\bar c
=\overline{(ab)c}.
\]
Since multiplication in $\mathbb Z$ is associative, $(ab)c=a(bc)$. Therefore,
\[
\overline{(ab)c}=\overline{a(bc)}=\bar a\cdot\overline{bc}=\bar a\cdot(\bar b\cdot\bar c).
\]
Thus multiplication of residue classes modulo $n$ is associative.
\end{proof}
